doc.heatDefinition: 1-month total-return proxy in USD: the unweighted mean of the available legs — sovereign bond price proxy converted to USD, country equity ETF return, regional EM corporate credit carry, and, for markets with no free sovereign curve, the currency return against the dollar. Green means positive compensation over the last month, red negative.

US.name: United States
US.heatBasis: unweighted mean of 2 live 1-month USD return proxies: bond, equity

bonds.notes: 10Y government bond yield — OECD long-term rate via FRED, monthly
bonds.usd_note: no currency leg — the local price proxy is used as-is

fx.note: United States — the US dollar is the base currency

equity_etf.label: SPY
equity_etf.note: US/LN-listed country ETF — USD-denominated, so the currency move is already inside this return

credit.why: developed market — no EM regional corporate OAS index covers it

sovereign_spread.note: 10Y yield minus the US 10Y — a sovereign risk proxy, not a traded CDS quote (no free CDS source exists)

riskPremium.label: Risk premium on lending (lending rate minus treasury bill rate, %)

structural.note: World Bank annual indicators — structural context, lagged by 1-2 years. Never used in heat.
